primary_comparison: M2 vs M0 under the primary model class (L2 logistic): Delta PR-AUC = PR-AUC(M2) - PR-AUC(M0)

primary_class.name: L2_LOGISTIC
primary_class.implementation: numpy/scipy (scipy.optimize.minimize, L-BFGS-B, gtol 1e-8, maxiter 5000); objective = sum of log-loss + 0.5 * lambda * ||beta||^2 over standardised features, intercept unpenalised
preprocessing_order: per-feature transform from the registries (log1p or none)
median imputation from the training rows + a <feature>_missing indicator for every feature with >= 1 missing training value
standardise with training mean / sd (sd 0 -> column dropped for that fit, recorded)
primary_class.calibration_policy: no post-hoc recalibration; calibration is measured, not repaired
primary_class.convergence: a fit that does not converge is retried once with maxiter 20000; a second failure is a DATA / DESIGN FAILURE

secondary_class.name: LIGHTGBM
secondary_class.implementation: lightgbm 4.7.0, objective binary, deterministic=True, force_row_wise=True, num_threads=1, seed 20261104, learning_rate 0.03, min_child_samples 200, subsample 0.8 (bagging_freq 1), colsample_bytree 0.8, reg_lambda 1.0, max_bin 255, no early stopping, verbose -1
secondary_class.preprocessing: raw features (no transform, no scaling); missing values passed as NaN (native handling); no indicators

equal_budget_rule: every arm gets exactly the same grid (5 lambdas; 4 tree configs), the same folds, the same preprocessing rules and the same seeds; no arm may receive an extra search, feature selection or early stopping
selection: for each arm and class separately: the configuration with the highest mean PR-AUC over the 8 development folds; ties broken by the stronger regularisation (larger lambda; fewer leaves, then fewer trees)
final_fit: selected configuration refit on all DEVELOPMENT landmarks; the holdout is scored once with that fit
sensitivity_reported: also at the a-priori defaults (lambda = 10; num_leaves 7 / 200 trees), to show selection optimism
no_feature_selection: no feature is dropped, added or transformed differently by any result

environment_pins.note: scikit-learn is not installed in the repository venv and is not used
